text:
Maya K: thinking of a tight 30m webinar: 'Inference Playbook: Low-latency cost wins' for infra + product leads. want actionable checklist + quick demos.
Liam H: happy to speak on runtime routing (7m) 1; will show a failover example.
Priya S: i'll take model+quant picks (8m) and export a benchmark slide.
Noah L: i'll demo a 6-step batching experiment (8m) with before/after numbers.
Maya K: need a customer 2-3m voice. Ben can you ask one?
Ben R: reached out to MapleHealth; they can do a 90s quote and a screenshot.
Maya K: draft run-of-show: 0:00 intro (Maya,1m) | 0:01 runtime routing (Liam,7m) | 0:08 batching lab (Noah,8m) | 0:16 model picks (Priya,8m) | 0:24 customer clip (Ben,2m) | 0:26 lightning q&a (all,4m) | 0:30 CTA (Maya,1m)
Priya S: suggest 7m Q&A if audience active.
Noah L: agree. also planning two rehearsal slots: tech check 7 days prior, full dress 1 day prior. availability: Tue 10/24 10:00 or Thu 10/26 16:00.
Liam H: Tue works for me.
Priya S: Thu preferred.
Ben R: both ok.
Maya K: ops-bot reserve both. Also need hero image, 2 social cards, one one-pager checklist PDF for post-event.
ops-bot: reserved Tue 1734569000 and Thu 1734655400 in #webinar-calendar. invites sent. :white_check_mark:
Maya K: landing page needs two abstract variants: engineer-first and product-first. Priya draft both.
Priya S: will post drafts this afternoon.
Maya K: inbound routing: attendees -> nurture sequence -> MQL rules -> demo handoff. Ben, can you own routing doc?
Ben R: will draft routing and automation steps, share by EOD Friday.
Maya K: final ask: speakers upload single-slide summary + 3 bullets by next Wed (1734572000). keep concise.
Noah L: noted.
Priya S: noted.
Liam H: noted.
Maya K: thanks everyone, will consolidate assets and push page copy after Priya posts abstracts.
